  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="uses-title">

      <h2 id="uses-title">Good Uses During the Course</h2>
      <p>AI is useful when the question is precise and when you keep track of what you verify.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="principle-grid">
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Explain</h3><p>Ask for an explanation of an R output, an error message or a step in the learning plan.</p></article>
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Check</h3><p>Submit your own code or interpretation and ask for targeted feedback.</p></article>
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Improve</h3><p>Ask for a clearer version, then choose what remains consistent with the instructions and your analysis.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="limits-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="limits-title">Before Using an Answer</h2>
      <p>A useful answer must be compatible with the instructions, the data and the code you actually ran.</p>
    </div>
    <ol class="clean-steps">
      <li>Reread the module or challenge instructions.</li>
      <li>Run the code in your own Quarto document.</li>
      <li>Check that variable names, filters and units match the data.</li>
      <li>Rewrite the interpretation in your own words.</li>
    </ol>
  </section>
